other.penalty:
Either waySummary: 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment : 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see paragraph 16 of the Schedule to the Environmental Protection (Wales) (Microbeads) Regulations 2018 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
